bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:360 on_monthly_pulse_country -> 6030 (events/origin_events_paragon.txt:5142-5198) when the ruler has the psionic Luminary trait and no Zro; paying 3 Zro keeps the ruler alive, otherwise the ruler dies.

label.zh: 统一承诺的结果
label.en: Outcome of the Unifying Promise

note.zh: 按兑现的承诺数（每15点为1级）判定：至少1级为兑现，否则为空头承诺。
note.en: Judged by promises delivered (every 15 points is one tier): at least one tier is a success, otherwise false promises.

label.zh: 十字路口：如何对待改革派
label.en: Crossroads: dealing with the reformists

note.zh: 谈判、开战、处决（妄想程度≥10）或倒向改革派（光耀者死去，帝国改制）。
note.en: Negotiate, go to war, execute (delusion tier >= 10) or side with the reformists (the Luminary dies and the state is reformed).

label.zh: 第二次机会：延续光耀者的方式
label.en: The Second Chance: how the Luminary lives on

note.zh: 维生装置、义体、灵能、合成或基因；部分选项需相应传统或合成帝国。
note.en: Apparatus, cybernetic, psionic, synthetic or genetic; some require the matching tradition or a synthetic empire.

label.zh: 外交里程碑
label.en: Diplomatic milestones

note.zh: 光耀者在位期间各出现一次，顺序不定。
note.en: Each happens once while the Luminary rules, in any order.

label.zh: 起源议程的随机洞见（四选一）
label.en: Random insight of the origin agenda (one of four)

label.zh: 天命已成
label.en: Destiny fulfilled

note.zh: 可维持现状或改行民主/寡头制（起源改为默认）。
note.en: Keep things as they are, or move to democracy/oligarchy (origin becomes the default).

label.zh: 光耀者逝去
label.en: The Luminary is gone

note.zh: 起源转为“光耀者已逝”状态。
note.en: The origin switches to its post-Luminary form.

label.zh: 改革派赢得内战
label.en: The reformists win the civil war

note.zh: 玩家倒向改革派后取胜。
note.en: After siding with the reformists.

label.zh: 一统天下
label.en: One Rule

note.zh: 镇压改革派叛乱后。
note.en: After crushing the reformist revolt.

label.zh: 谈判达成和平
label.en: Peace by negotiation

note.zh: 与改革派和解。
note.en: Reconciled with the reformists.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选择帝制（a）进入加冕与“异见崛起”“改革派诉求”两段局势；维持独裁（b）则在10–20年与20–30年后分别出现正面与负面特质事件。
notes.en: Review note: choosing the empire (a) leads to the coronation and the Dissidence and Reformist situations; staying a dictatorship (b) brings a positive and a negative trait event 10-20 and 20-30 years later.

scope.zh: 核对开局、统一承诺局势及其随机问题、议程洞见、首个殖民地、外交里程碑、帝制路线（加冕、异见、改革派、十字路口与四种结局）、独裁路线、飞升演说与第二次机会、光耀者去世。
scope.en: Checked the opening, the Unifying Promise and its random problems, agenda insights, the first colony, diplomatic milestones, the imperial line (coronation, dissidence, reformists, crossroads and outcomes), the dictatorship line, the ascension speech and Second Chance, and the Luminary's death.

uncertain: The reformist civil war ending depends on war outcomes and the hidden failsafe 5950; the archive shows the routes only.
